paper: Forward Propagation of Information and Context by Scalar Value for Reconstructible Lossless Continuity of Context from WordNet Box Kites
engine: VAPMIP monad (monad.py, harness.py, PtolC/); conversational-ingest service live 2026-08-30
claim: Context forward-propagates turn-by-turn carrying only scalar values (one Riemann-zero address gamma per token, plus tier-0 field scalars beta, E, Gamma); the full WordNet box-kite algebraic structure reconstructs from those addresses exactly, zero loss, deterministically. No dense multiplication table / adjacency tensor / attention matrix is stored or propagated.

domain_decomposition.lineage_verdict: no new generator required; box-kite apparatus is Laurelin composite (tier 2-3), regenerated from tier-0 generators + address
domain_decomposition.emergence_note: the (w_sem, w_ctx) split asserts beta orthogonal to A; an asserted orthogonality made computable IS i = sqrt(SIGN); the vector is the 2-D shadow of that assertion; i is a known consequence of SIGN under Cayley-Dickson doubling

predictions.name: structural losslessness
predictions.statement: For every word in a real ingested corpus, the Assessor membership, box-kite chart, zero-divisor partner set, and 19-relation adjacency reconstructed from gamma alone EQUAL those from the materialised 16-D sedenion + WordNet computation.

predictions.name: fold-order invariance
predictions.statement: Ingesting the same turns in any permutation of fold order yields a byte-identical monad.bin.

predictions.name: no collision
predictions.statement: Over the ingested vocabulary the map w -> (gamma, E) is injective.
predictions.quantity: count of distinct words sharing an address

predictions.name: the 16-to-1 fold
predictions.statement: sigma^16 reduces to the single signed scalar Gamma = (P_red - P_blue)/(P_red + P_blue) = 2*sigma_self - 1 = tanh(u/2), u = ln(P_red/P_blue); reconstruction of the 16 channels from Gamma and the address is exact.
predictions.quantity: max abs error, reconstructed 16-vector vs materialised, over all queries

predictions.name: geometric continuity (weak leg: faithful, not exact)
predictions.statement: Context carried forward as scalars and rebuilt reproduces the co-occurrence neighbourhood (A-matrix basin) of a held concept to within the field's own max(existing, new) deepen rule.
predictions.quantity: Jaccard(rebuilt basin, materialised basin) at k=20, IDF-weighted
predictions.note: MAY be shown unfaithful without touching P1-P4; structural losslessness and dynamical faithfulness are registered separately.
predictions.falsifies_claim_if: does NOT falsify the structural claim; informs the dynamical claim only

falsifier: one box-kite relation the materialised computation produces that does not reconstruct from the scalar addresses alone
two distinct contexts that propagate to the same scalar set (a collision that unpacks)
monad.bin not byte-identical under a fold-order permutation
